answer: The simulator at tools/council/simulate.py seats a CouncilSpec cast of scripted personas, drives tools.council.phases.PhaseMachine end to end, and emits a canonical transcript. Two runs on seed 257 hashed to 8b9f242fe78fb39aed3a3adf5bfe1e1654a2bd386931c9825e0b3ea76220fca9; seed 8257 hashed to 343cff890a5e2fd01d62e11ef3d7864bcc9d5c5d5a49f8695f186ff6e84e5863 (seedless bodies 7f218b4a82d547ced506b6b5e34c1c06ec157bf6288b800d59744a42c302513f vs db35a87d28e3b10ea6d912037db333d7b83cc3106956e3f9bb2f11081063f1a7). Critic is a dissenter. A gutted critic script raised PersonaScriptError and did not mint a default participant. model_calls=0. SUCCESS:TST-0257

evidence.claim: Same-seed transcripts are byte-identical; both hashes printed.
Different seed changes the seedless transcript body, so the seed is wired.
Scripted critic dissent appears in transcript.dissenters.
Corrupt critic script raises PersonaScriptError; no default seat.

inputs_on_this_tree.note: This unit owns the simulator. It does not rebuild the missing B05 protocol catalogue or the CouncilSpec compiler (that is the ADV circle). The runtime kernel used is the shipped PhaseMachine. Fixture CouncilSpec is local to this probe.

negative_control.message: persona critic.tracks must be a non-empty list

question: Implementation target: build the simulator that every other calibration probe in this lane rides on. Given a CouncilSpec plus a cast of SCRIPTED personas (a persona is a seeded state machine emitting pre-authored positions, votes and citations, not a live model call), run the council runtime end to end and emit a transcript that is byte-identical across two runs on the same seed.

tests.name: Two full runs on seed A produce identical transcript sha256.
Seed B produces a different hash, including the seedless body.
A persona scripted to dissent appears as a dissenter.

tests.message: persona critic.tracks must be a non-empty list
tests.name: Corrupt persona script fails loudly; no default participant.

title: Deterministic council simulator with scripted personas and byte-reproducible transcripts
